newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine graft row won't hurt investment - minister.
newsitem.headline: Argentine graft row won't hurt investment - minister.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez predicted Friday that a controvery over alleged corruption in the cabinet would blow over within days and that it will have no impact on investment.

"It had an effect one day at a time when the markets were weak around the world," Fernandez told reporters before speaking to an institute for executives and finance. "But it recovered yesterday and (the dispute) will not affect investments."

Former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo triggered nervousness in local markets earlier this week with allegations that the interior and justice ministers covered up corruption and manipulated judges. The government denied the charges.
"The impact was largely local but I don't think it will have any fallout," Fernandez said. "After a few days it will disappear completely."
